description: Header file defining the 'Channel' class within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, implementing WebSocket link handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and request management for a plugin framework.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket channel with JSON and text message handling, serialization/deserialization, and request management.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Encapsulates either a JSON element or a text string for message handling.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements for outbound messages.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data streams into JSON elements.

methods.name: Channel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with a socket and remote ID.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the channel.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the channel.

methods.name: IsNotified
methods.description: Checks if the channel has notification flag set.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Enqueues a text message or JSON element for sending.

methods.name: RequestOutbound
methods.description: Triggers the channel to send data.

methods.name: SetId
methods.description: Sets the channel's ID.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the channel for thread safety.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the channel.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets the channel's state and notification flag.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes data for outbound transmission based on current state.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data stream into JSON or text.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Virtual method to handle incoming WebRequest.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Virtual method called when a request is received.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Virtual method to send a WebResponse.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Virtual method to send a JSON element.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns the current JSON element to send.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON elements.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Virtual method to send raw data.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Virtual method to receive raw data.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Virtual method called when text data is received.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Virtual method called on state change.
